subject: history_social
passage: The Shah Jahan Mosque in Thatta, in Pakistan's Sindh province, was completed in 1647 under the Mughal emperor whose name it bears. Its most striking feature is its tilework: the walls and the ninety-three domes are lined with glazed tiles in blue and white, arranged in patterns that shift as a visitor moves through the arcades. The mosque is also admired for its acoustics, since a prayer spoken at the mihrab can be heard at the far end of the building. It follows the imperial style of the period in most ______ it has no minarets, a feature of nearly every other great Mughal mosque.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "It follows the imperial style of the period in most respects" is a complete sentence, and "it has no minarets" is another. Two independent clauses can be joined by a comma followed by a coordinating conjunction such as "but."
explanation.A: Incorrect. A comma alone cannot join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The comma after "but" wrongly separates the conjunction from the clause it introduces; nothing in that clause needs setting off.
explanation.C: Incorrect. When "but" joins two independent clauses, a comma is needed before it.
explanation.D: Correct. A comma plus the conjunction "but" correctly joins the two independent clauses.
